title: Typesafe Jev and LLM assisted trading
author: engineering-AF7
selftext:
At [alphaflowseven.com](http://alphaflowseven.com) we are running an experiment with Jev where it assists the LLM with very frequent check-ins on the position and the market conditions. Under certain circumstances it will invoke the LLM for decision making. We are running in shadow mode, but it turns out that this is a valuable complement to LLMs and will increase alpha marginally over time. 

\#aitrading #jev #typesafe

[Some of the questions posed](https://preview.redd.it/ylervws1pzth1.png?width=1846&format=png&auto=webp&s=b3902ea7bc6e8bed300d185af150c97b07d2a2b1)
